Not checked by somebody else's code. 0.9.1: tests/study-area.test.mjs (an enclave starting on its hole's east edge is accepted, and refused without the hole; fails on 0.9.0's check) and tests/mers-from-scratch.browser.mjs (South Korea's 17 provinces as a study area); Chromium. 0.9.2: tests/boundary-source.test.mjs (South Korea, north korea, Vietnam resolve; Korea alone does not; the other names are all Natural Earth's where they differ).
